notes: Identity independently checked in canonical text: title Replication of a research claim from Sandra and Otto (2018), Cognition; author Daniel C. Molden; project Sandra_Cognition_2018_0qar - Molden - Direct Replication - 20g; OSF project w8xun and source download xkwj9 match assigned reference/project. The assigned reference labels it New Data Replication while the report labels it Direct Replication. This is a primary replication results report with claim, criteria, results, deviations and materials sections, not a preregistration or abstract excerpt. No PDF was supplied. The original citation matches the assigned Sandra and Otto Cognition reference, but the original primary paper was not inspected. The report explicitly identifies the key SCORE H* claim as the NFC x trial type x reward interaction on log reaction time, establishing the focal target independently of row order and numeric matching. H1 Stroop interference and H2 anticipated intrinsic motivation are explicitly additional hypotheses. The significant NFC interaction on task accuracy is an alternative outcome and is not substituted for H*. Printed ß=.0063 is retained, with t=1.336 separately; no conversion to ser_method_t. Page 3 documents z-scoring individual difference measures and continuous DVs including logRT around the grand mean for focal analyses; this does not establish standardization of every design regressor. N=127 is explicitly the final analytic participant sample and appears in Replication Result as well. Recruitment count 210; 68 returned, 10 rejected, four timed out; 128 met performance criteria and one additional participant was excluded for incomplete questionnaire responses. No analytic N sum or df derivation used. Practice trials excluded and incorrect responses eliminated for logRT analyses; number of analytic trials is not given. Focal verdict is explicitly failed; the authors describe a separate accuracy alternative as consistent with the original claim.
